capabilities: encode text to base16, base32, base64, base85
decode base16, base32, base64, base85 back to text
encode and decode text with ROT13
encode and decode text with Atbash
trigger conversions by typing Markdown keywords in notes
extras: README names the plugin 'Transcoder' while the plugin id is 'coder'; roadmap lists planned ciphers (Vigenere, Hex, Morse, ascii art) not yet implemented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to encode or decode text with ciphers and base encodings inside notes.
summary: Text encoding plugin that encodes and decodes text with Base16, Base32, Base64, Base85, ROT13 and Atbash via Markdown keywords.
